gaps.needs: Every elliptic curve E/ℚ is attached to a normalized weight-two trivial-character newform of exact arithmetic conductor, with equal traces at all good primes.

For prime ℓ≥5 and irreducible E[ℓ] of Serre weight 2 and prime-to-ℓ Artin conductor N, supply a primitive weight-two trivial-character newform of exact level N and a prime λ above ℓ whose residual representation is E[ℓ].

For prime ℓ≥3 and irreducible E[ℓ], supply the weight-two trivial-character lift at the deletion level M₀ of Bennett–Siksek §2, equation (3), with good-prime and removed-multiplicative-prime trace congruences of Lemma 2.1.
For E/ℚ and an odd prime ℓ, supply the arithmetic conductor M of E, the prime-to-ℓ Artin conductor N(E[ℓ]) and the Serre weight of E[ℓ].
gaps.section: elliptic local conductors and Serre weights

gaps.needs: For E/ℚ and an odd prime ℓ, complex conjugation on E[ℓ] has determinant −1 and eigenvalues 1 and −1.
For an odd prime ℓ, an irreducible two-dimensional 𝔽_ℓ-representation of the absolute Galois group of ℚ on which complex conjugation has eigenvalues 1 and −1 is absolutely irreducible.
For an odd prime p and H≤GL₂(𝔽ₚ) not containing SL₂(𝔽ₚ), H lies in a Borel subgroup or a split or nonsplit Cartan normalizer, or its projective image is isomorphic to A₄, S₄ or A₅.

For a primitive weight-two trivial-character newform f of level N and a coefficient-field prime λ above ℓ, supply its two-dimensional residual representation with arithmetic-Frobenius polynomial T²−c_q T+q at every prime q∤Nℓ.
For a primitive weight-two trivial-character newform f of level N with coefficient-field degree d, its associated modular abelian variety A_f has arithmetic conductor Nᵈ, in particular N when d=1.

For r>0 and p prime with gcd(r,p)=1, supply the smooth projective normalizations over ℚ of X₀(r)×_{X(1)}X_H(p), for H a Borel, split Cartan normalizer or nonsplit Cartan normalizer, with their j maps, cusps and smooth integral models at primes q∤6rp.
For r>0 and p prime with gcd(r,p)=1, supply the Jacobians over ℚ of the mixed Borel and Cartan-normalizer curves, with pull-push Hecke correspondences T_n for n prime to p.
gaps.section: mixed modular Jacobians and Hecke maps

gaps.needs: For a primitive rational weight-two trivial-character newform f of level N, supply the elliptic quotient of J₀(N) attached to f, identifying its residual representations with those of f.

For a finite extension K/ℚ_q with absolute ramification index e<q−1 and an exact sequence 0→B→J→A→0 of abelian varieties over K with J semistable, the identity components of their Néron models give an exact sequence of free O_K-modules 0→Cot₀(A)→Cot₀(J)→Cot₀(B)→0.
